feeds.title: Association for Behavior Analysis International
feeds.description: Covers articles on behavior analysis research, behavior analytic literature, behavioral science on autism, symbolic behavior, behavior analytic research, verbal behavior and many more. The Association for Behavior Analysis International is a nonprofit scientific membership organization dedicated to the promotion of behavior analysis.

feeds.title: Behavioral Scientist
feeds.description: The blog covers original and thought-provoking reports from the front lines of behavioral science on today's most pressing social, political, economic, and technological challenges with a focus on original columns and commentaries from leading academic and applied behavioral scientists. Behavioral Scientist is a non-profit digital magazine that offers readers original, thought-provoking reports from the front lines of behavioral science.

feeds.title: Annals Of Behavioural Science
feeds.description: The blog covers a range of topics including Behavioral therapy, Behavioral Counselling, Psychological Behaviroal Science, Behavioral Genetics and more. Annals of Behavioural Science journal is a high impact peer review journal which publishes original research articles related to behavioral science.

feeds.title: BehavioralEconomics.com Blog
feeds.description: BehavioralEconomics.com is home to the popular Behavioral Economics Guide, a global social network (Behavioral Economics Group), the Behavioral Economics Academy, and a blog that publishes the latest behavioral insights from academia, business, and public policy.

feeds.title: Lirio » Behavioral Science
feeds.description: Covers numerous articles on Artifical Intelligence and Behavioral Science. Lirio is a behavior change AI platform that unites behavioral science with artificial intelligence to nudge patients and employees in the right direction.

feeds.title: Change Talk Blog
feeds.description: An expert in behavior change, substance use disorders and empathic communication, Dr. Alyssa Forcehimes serves as President of The Change Companies® and Train for Change Inc.® She lives in Arizona with her husband and two daughters.

feeds.title: Deric's Mind Blog
feeds.description: Deric Bownds, the author of this blog has more than 35 years of experience in research and understanding of how vision works. His articles report new ideas and works on the mind, brain, behavior, psychology, and politics as well as random curious stuff.

feeds.title: economics, psychology, policy
feeds.description: This blog is maintained by Professor Liam Delaney to discuss issues at the intersection of economics, psychology, and policy, and emerging fields such as behavioural public policy and behavioural public administration.

feeds.title: Behavioural Public Policy Blog
feeds.description: The blog provides expert opinions and analysis from all areas of behavioural science and the policy implications that can be drawn from research. A companion blog to the journal Behavioural Public Policy, it also provides a home for the varied community of people interested in behavioural public policy.

feeds.title: Notes from Two Scientific Psychologists
feeds.description: The blog showcases research on perception, action, language & embodied cognitive science. The blog is created by two psychologists who are interested in developing a more coherent, naturalised approach to the scientific study of human behaviour.

feeds.title: Center for Advanced Hindsight Blog
feeds.description: Covers topics such as behavioral research, behavioral economics & psychology, events, resources and more. Center for Advanced Hindsight makes people happier, healthier, and wealthier with behavioral science, at home and abroad.

feeds.title: Progress-Focused
feeds.description: Cover topics like mindset, motivation, personal progress, and education. This Website created by Coert Visser is all about the progress-focused approach, where experienced psychologist Coert Visser intertwines personality and character traits, and personal and professional development, from a psychological perspective.

feeds.title: SUE Behavioural Design Blog
feeds.description: Cover topics such as citizen behaviour, customer and financial behaviour, behavioural design and behavioural economics. SUE is a Behavioural Design Consultancy. We advise and train our clients to improve their offerings through the science of influence.
